checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is block header bloom field validated against computed logs_bloom from transaction receipts?

reachability.notes: Attacker sends block with header bloom that does not match the combined receipt blooms. If not verified, incorrect bloom data propagates.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify all entry points where blocks are received from P2P peers. 2. Trace the block validation flow to locate where header bloom is compared against computed bloom. 3. Verify that bloom recomputation occurs by iterating all transaction receipts and combining their logs_bloom fields. 4. Craft a malicious block with valid transactions but a header bloom that differs from the computed bloom. 5. Submit this block via P2P and verify it is rejected with appropriate error. 6. Check that rejection occurs before block is stored or propagated. 7. Verify consensus clients and execution clients both enforce this validation.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0050, Trust Boundaries: tb-001, tb-008. Header bloom mismatch indicates tampered or incorrect receipt data. Causes consensus divergence between validating and non-validating clients. PoC must demonstrate a block with mismatched header bloom being accepted.

checklist.title: Verify Bloom Computation Correctness: Is logs_bloom correctly aggregated from all receipt blooms?

reachability.notes: Attacker sends block with header bloom that does not match the combined receipt blooms. If not verified, incorrect bloom data propagates.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Locate the bloom aggregation logic in the codebase. 2. Verify that the aggregation uses bitwise OR across all receipt logs_bloom fields. 3. Test with blocks containing zero, one, and multiple transactions to ensure correct aggregation. 4. Verify edge case handling: empty receipts, receipts with no logs, maximum size blooms. 5. Confirm that off-by-one errors in receipt iteration are not possible.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0050, Supporting check for bloom computation integrity. Incorrect aggregation could lead to false acceptance of invalid blocks.

checklist.title: Verify P2P to Execution Engine Trust Boundary: Is bloom validation performed before block acceptance?

reachability.notes: Attacker sends block with header bloom that does not match the combined receipt blooms. If not verified, incorrect bloom data propagates.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Map the data flow from P2P peer (actor-p2p-peer) to execution engine (actor-execution-engine). 2. Identify trust boundary tb-001 and tb-008 crossing points. 3. Verify bloom validation occurs at the boundary before data enters the execution engine. 4. Confirm that untrusted peer data cannot bypass validation. 5. Check that validation errors result in block rejection and peer scoring/banning as appropriate.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0050, Edges: tb-001, tb-008, Nodes: actor-p2p-peer, actor-execution-engine. Critical boundary check to prevent consensus divergence.
